adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the `try/catch` around `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` catches `err` but only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and discards the error object. The handler then continues and returns success (`{ message: "Guests added" }`), so the client `onSuccess` path will show the "Guests added" toast even if email delivery fails. This is a real, diff-grounded observability/operability issue rather than a hard functional defect.
